description:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Open to leaders and ICs across all four bets. Apply once; we will route you to the bet that fits.

About New Ventures

New Ventures is an org at Socure where our best bets get funded and we need 0-1 Builders to make it a customers reality. We are not maintaining a product line. We are building new ones, each with a single-threaded owner, a small senior team, and a direct line to the company's identity and risk data.

If you want to own something from the first commit or prototype to the first customer, these are the roles for you at Socure.

Roles We Are Hiring

Founding Leadership

  • Head of Agent Intelligence

  • Head of Workforce Verification

  • Head of Engineering, CRA

Individual Contributors

  • Staff Engineer

  • Staff Backend Engineer

  • Staff ML Engineer

  • Senior AI Engineer

  • AI Engineer

  • Software Engineer II

  • Other roles as the bets scale

What You Will Do

  • Build zero-to-one products with real customers, real data, and real stakes.

  • Own outcomes end to end, from design through production and iteration.

  • Work across Digital Intelligence, Identity, and Risk platforms to turn existing signals into new products.

  • Ship fast, measure honestly, and kill or double down based on evidence.

  • For leaders: set strategy, hire the team, get in the weeds, and be accountable for the bet's P&L-level results.

What We Look For

  • A record of building new things, not only running existing ones.

  • Fail fast and 0-1 builder mentality

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the judgment to make decisions without a playbook.

  • Strong technical depth in your craft: backend, ML, AI/agentic systems, or engineering leadership.

  • Bias to action and clear communication.

  • Interest in identity, fraud, trust, or AI agents. Direct experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Why New Ventures

  • Funded bets with executive sponsorship.

  • Real ownership. Single-threaded leaders, no committee decisions.

  • Foundation of Socure's identity data and customer base on day one.

  • Early-team scope and impact, with the stability of an established company.

How We Hire

One application covers every role above. Our recruiting team routes candidates to the right bet and role. Process: recruiter screen, Bar Raiser conversation, technical and behavioral loop.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.
